title: OperatorSession.v1
description: OperatorSession.v1 (plan §4): the canonical, resumable operator state. Provider (Claude/Codex/etc.) session IDs are children of it, never replacements.

updatedAt.description: When the session was last updated.

routeDecision.description: The resolved route, or null before routing completes.

workflowTemplateId.description: Selected WorkflowTemplate.templateId, or null before selection.

executionGraph.description: The compiled graph, or null before compilation.

nodeStates.description: Per-node current NodeState, keyed by nodeId.

providerSessionIds.description: Per-node child provider session id, keyed by nodeId.

humanDecisions.description: Recorded human decisions against opened gates.

artifacts.description: Every artifact produced within this session.

evidence.description: Every evidence record captured within this session.

terminalResult.description: The terminal result, or null before the session reaches a terminal state.

openGateId.description: Open HumanGate.gateId awaiting a decision. Required exactly when currentState is AWAITING_HUMAN; absent otherwise (plan §9).

Abstention.description: Whether the operator abstained from a confident automatic route (plan §6).

reason.description: Why the operator abstained. Required and non-empty when abstained is true.

ArtifactManifest.description: ArtifactManifest.v1 (plan §11): typed record of a produced artifact.

artifactType.description: Artifact contract type, e.g. implementation-plan.v1, patch.v1, test-evidence.v1 (plan §11).

location.description: Opaque, resolvable storage reference/URI for the artifact content.

contentSummary.description: Concise, decision-oriented summary of the artifact content; never a raw reasoning trace.

policyRefs.description: Versioned policy citations governing this artifact.

BudgetEffect.description: Effect of a route on the active budget profile.

BudgetState.description: Live budget accounting for an OperatorSession (plan §10).

Confidence.description: Confidence/abstention tier (plan §6). LOW never automatically selects a more expensive model or council.

ContextPolicy.description: Context isolation policy for a node's inputs (plan §11).

Evidence.description: Evidence.v1 (plan §11): a claim grounded in a concrete, independently checkable source.

source.description: Where the evidence originated (command, tool, or observation source); portable, no hardcoded usernames/paths.

artifact.description: Referenced ArtifactManifest.artifactId, when the evidence is backed by a stored artifact.

claim.description: The specific claim this evidence supports or refutes.

producer.description: Role or nodeId that produced this evidence.

EvidenceType.description: Kind of evidence backing a claim.

EvidenceVerificationStatus.description: Whether a claim's evidence has been independently verified.

ExecutionGraph.description: ExecutionGraph.v1 (plan §4, §7): the compiled, session-bound instantiation of a WorkflowTemplate.

graphRevision.description: Monotonic revision counter; bound by HumanGate.graphRevision approvals.

graphHash.description: Content hash of the compiled graph; bound by HumanGate.graphHash approvals.

allOf.$comment: Structural parity only: requires at least 2 nodes to declare a groupId when executionShape is PARALLEL or COUNCIL. JSON Schema draft 2020-12 cannot assert that those nodes share the same groupId value; the full group-membership and exactly-one-synthesisOwner-per-group invariants must be enforced by validators/tests.

role.description: Template role name this node fills.

groupId.description: Parallel/council group identifier, when this node is part of one.

synthesisOwner.description: Whether this node is the required operator-synthesis owner for its group (plan §7).

verificationOwnerNodeId.description: Independent verification-owner nodeId. Required and distinct from nodeId whenever mutation is present.

consumes.description: Artifact contract types this node consumes (plan §11).

produces.description: Artifact contract types this node produces (plan §11).

ExecutionStatus.description: Typed execution status (plan §14), independent of workflowStatus.

FallbackDecision.description: One role-compatible fallback decision applied while routing (plan §10).

FinalOperatorResult.description: FinalOperatorResult.v1 (plan §14): the one decision-oriented terminal result rendered to the human. Only Agent Operator produces this; leaf agents recommend dispositions for their own findings only. Contains no chain-of-thought fields.

recommendationRationale.description: Mandatory. Must cite: conditions satisfied, conditions unsatisfied, blockers considered, deferred findings considered, remaining risk, and the exact policy rules producing the recommendation (plan §14).

FinalOperatorResultExecution.description: Execution block of FinalOperatorResult.v1. actionsNotPerformed explicitly names omitted actions (commit, push, merge, Jira transition, deployment, production mutation, publication); "implementation complete" never implies these occurred (plan §14).

workPerformed.description: Concise, decision-oriented statements of work performed; never a raw reasoning trace.

changesMade.description: Concise statements of concrete changes made.

actionsNotPerformed.description: Explicitly omitted actions, e.g. commit, push, deployment.

FinalOperatorResultFindings.description: Findings block of FinalOperatorResult.v1: findingId references bucketed by disposition.

required.description: Whether a human decision is required to progress.

gateId.description: Open HumanGate.gateId. Required when required is true.

options.description: Options offered by the gate. Required and non-empty when required is true.

FinalOperatorResultNext.description: Next-actions block of FinalOperatorResult.v1. Permission (allowedActions) and recommendation are never conflated.

recommendedAction.description: At most one action; must be a member of allowedActions when present.

policyRefs.description: Versioned policy citations for the terminal result.

FinalOperatorResultScope.description: Scope block of FinalOperatorResult.v1. Scope compliance and behavioral verification are separate decisions.

deviations.description: Every approved or detected scope deviation.

FinalOperatorResultStatus.description: Status block of FinalOperatorResult.v1. executionStatus and workflowStatus are independent (plan §14).

HumanDecisionRecord.description: A recorded human decision against one HumanGate, bound to the exact graph/artifact state that was approved (plan §9).

outcome.description: Whether this decision approved or rejected the gate's requested decision (plan §9).

graphHashAtDecision.description: Must equal the session's executionGraph.graphHash at decision time (plan §9: approval binds exactly to session/gate/graphHash).

artifactHashesAtDecision.description: Content hashes of every artifact the approval was bound to.

JournalEntry.description: One compact workflow journal event (plan §4): records timestamp, event type, session, node/gate if applicable, reason code, and artifact/evidence references. Never hidden reasoning.

eventType.description: Short uppercase-snake event token, e.g. CLASSIFIED, GATE_APPROVED.

message.description: Concise, decision-oriented event message; never a raw reasoning trace.

MutationClass.description: Declared/instantiated mutation class for a node (plan §4).

MutationMetadata.description: Concrete mutation metadata attached to an instantiated ExecutionGraph node (plan §4 idempotency).

NodeState.description: Execution graph node lifecycle state (plan §3). UNKNOWN is required after crash/restart when a previously RUNNING node cannot yet be proven completed or failed.

PolicyRef.description: Versioned policy citation, e.g. masar@3:review.maxRounds or secure-code@2:independentVerification (plan §5, §6).

RejectedAlternative.description: One rejected routing alternative, with reason code (plan §2 /operator why).

RequirementCoverageItem.description: Status of one frozen required item (plan §14: passing tests never implies complete requirement coverage).

RequirementCoverageStatus.description: Status of one frozen required item within requirementCoverage.

RetryPolicy.description: Adapter-declared retry policy for a mutation node (plan §4).

RiskLevel.description: Risk classification carried by a RouteDecision.

RoleAssignment.description: One role-to-provider selection within a RouteDecision.

role.description: Template role name, e.g. planner, independent-reviewer.

provider.description: Concrete provider/role name selected, e.g. opus, codex-high.

RouteDecision.description: RouteDecision.v1 (plan §6): deterministic routing/compilation output for one request.

selectedRolesProviders.description: Roles/providers selected to fill each required template capability.

fallbackDecisions.description: Role-compatible fallback decisions applied while routing.

reasonCodes.description: Typed reason codes justifying this route.

policyRefs.description: Versioned policy citations for this route (plan §6: every policy-derived route cites policyRefs).

ScopeDeviation.description: One approved or detected scope deviation (plan §14).

description.description: What deviated from the frozen scope.

approved.description: Whether this deviation was explicitly approved.

policyRefs.description: Versioned policy citations for this deviation.

ScopeStatus.description: Scope compliance status (plan §14), separate from behavioral verification.

StopDetail.description: Structured stop/disposition detail (plan §3: every stop includes reason, affected node, evidence, retry eligibility, required decision or missing prerequisite, and next allowed action). Populated on an OperatorSession whenever currentState is BLOCKED or NEEDS_REPLAN.

retryEligible.description: Whether the affected node/session may be retried.

requiredDecisionOrPrerequisite.description: What decision or missing prerequisite must be resolved.

nextAllowedActions.description: Operator commands legally available from this stop.

StopReasonCode.description: Typed stop and disposition reason code (plan §3).

providers.description: Providers used, e.g. omp-role, claude, codex.

WorkflowStatus.description: Typed workflow status (plan §14), independent of executionStatus.
